## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` pass.

- [ ] Tried in the running app (`bun run dev`), not only in tests.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or personal data.
- [ ] Workflow changes: actions pinned to full SHAs, minimal `permissions`.
